hook.say: Can you name the city? Five questions, three seconds each. Careful with the last one!

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.q: Which city is home to the Christ the Redeemer statue?
questions.fact: The statue is 30 meters tall and has watched over Rio since 1931.
questions.sayAnswer: Rio de Janeiro! The statue is 30 meters tall, and has watched over the city since 1931.

questions.q: Which city has the world's tallest building, the Burj Khalifa?
questions.say: Which city has the world's tallest building, the Burj Khalifa?
questions.fact: The Burj Khalifa is 828 meters tall and opened in 2010.
questions.sayAnswer: Dubai! The Burj Khalifa is 828 meters tall, and opened in 2010.

questions.q: Which Italian city is built on more than 100 small islands?
questions.fact: Venice has canals instead of streets, and around 400 bridges.
questions.sayAnswer: Venice! It has canals instead of streets, and around 400 bridges.

questions.q: Which city was once called Constantinople?
questions.fact: Before that it was Byzantium. The world switched to Istanbul in 1930.
questions.sayAnswer: Istanbul! Before that, it was called Byzantium. The world switched to the name Istanbul in 1930.

questions.q: Which is the northernmost capital of a sovereign country?
questions.fact: Reykjavik, Iceland, sits at 64 degrees north, near the Arctic Circle.
questions.sayAnswer: Rake-ya-vik! The capital of Iceland sits at 64 degrees north, near the Arctic Circle.
